name: NinjaPrompt
author: chainloaded
description: Sidebar chat + agent loop between an OpenAI-format model and Binary Ninja's built-in MCP server.
longdescription: Add any OpenAI-compatible model, chat in the sidebar, and let the model use Binary Ninja's MCP tools. Chats are stored in the .bndb.

installinstructions.Darwin: Copy the folder into ~/Library/Application Support/Binary Ninja/plugins
